[Benzinga news, 2026-10-30T13:02:09Z, by staff] First Hawaiian and TriCo Bancshares Receive Shareholder Approvals for Acquisition
First Hawaiian, Inc. and TriCo Bancshares have jointly announced that their respective stockholders and shareholders have approved the proposed acquisition of TriCo by First Hawaiian.
First Hawaiian, Inc. and TriCo Bancshares announced that they have secured all necessary approvals from their respective shareholders regarding the planned acquisition of TriCo Bancshares by First Hawaiian. The companies expect the transaction to close later in 2026, pending the satisfaction of remaining customary closing conditions. This milestone marks a significant step in the business combination between the two financial institutions.
